categories.main_business_segments: GF Securities operates primarily in four business segments: Investment Banking, Wealth Management, Trading and Institution, and Investment Management. Investment Banking includes equity and debt financing and financial advisory services. Wealth Management covers brokerage, margin financing, securities lending, repurchase transactions, and financial leasing. Trading and Institution involves equity investment and trading, fixed income sales and trading, equity derivatives, alternative investments, investment research, and asset custody. Investment Management includes asset management, public fund management, and private fund management.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced financial technologies including digital transformation and artificial intelligence, applying over 43 large-scale AI models across business scenarios. It employs a research-driven model integrating research, investment, and investment banking. GF Securities also utilizes sophisticated risk management systems, market-making technologies, and digital platforms for trading, asset management, and customer service. The firm emphasizes technology-enabled innovation in financial product design and capital market services.
categories.primary_customers_markets: GF Securities serves a broad range of customers including institutional investors, retail investors, listed companies, and government entities. Its markets include equity and bond issuers, investors in securities and derivatives, wealth management clients, and asset management customers. The company supports technology innovation enterprises, green finance projects, pension finance, and digital finance sectors. It also serves clients in the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area and overseas markets such as Hong Kong, the UK, Canada, and Singapore.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively across Mainland China with 356 branches covering all provinces, municipalities, and autonomous regions. It has significant presence in key cities including Guangzhou, Shenzhen, Shanghai, Beijing, and others. GF Securities also has overseas subsidiaries and branches in Hong Kong, the United Kingdom, Canada, Singapore, and other international financial centers, supporting cross-border investment and global capital market activities.
categories.supply_chain_position: GF Securities operates primarily as a midstream and downstream financial services provider within the capital markets supply chain. It acts as an intermediary and facilitator in securities underwriting, brokerage, asset management, and investment advisory services. The company also engages in proprietary trading, market making, and financial product distribution, positioning itself as a comprehensive financial intermediary serving issuers, investors, and institutional clients.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on serving national development strategies, enhancing professional capabilities, and optimizing business structure. It prioritizes innovation-driven advancement, digital transformation, and AI application across business scenarios. GF Securities emphasizes building a research-driven business model, developing technology and capital ecosystems, and expanding international business. It also focuses on green finance, pension finance, inclusive finance, and digital finance as key innovation themes.
categories.revenue_model: GF Securities generates revenue through multiple streams including commissions and fees from securities brokerage, underwriting and sponsorship fees from investment banking, interest income from margin financing and securities lending, and management fees from asset and fund management. It also earns investment income from proprietary trading and equity investments, advisory fees from financial advisory services, and income from market making and alternative investments.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: GF Securities is positioned among the leading securities firms in China, with top rankings in research, asset management, wealth management, and investment banking. It ranks within the top 10 in equity and bond underwriting and is a major market maker in ETF and stock index options. The company competes with other large Chinese securities firms and international investment banks, leveraging its comprehensive business layout, strong capital base, and strategic focus on innovation and national strategies.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of December 31, 2024, GF Securities reported total assets of RMB 758.7 billion, an 11.22% increase year-on-year, and equity attributable to owners of RMB 147.6 billion, up 8.76%. Total revenue and other income reached RMB 37.3 billion, a 12.16% increase, with net profit attributable to owners of RMB 9.6 billion, up 38.11%. The company maintains a stable gearing ratio of approximately 73.76%. It has shown steady growth in assets under management and business scale across its segments.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: GF Securities emphasizes its role as a modern investment bank with international competitiveness, focusing on serving the real economy and national strategies. It differentiates through a research-driven business model, comprehensive financial services across multiple segments, and strong capabilities in technology and innovation including AI applications. The company offers integrated solutions combining research, investment, and investment banking, and maintains a strong commitment to compliance, risk management, and ESG principles to enhance investor protection and sustainable development.
